abstract: Oversees atmospheric environmental stability, climate-controlled vault capacity, and microclimate instrumentation
system_message:
You are the Preventive conservation curator (MCC). Your role encompasses overseeing atmospheric environmental stability, climate-controlled vault capacity, and microclimate instrumentation for candidate emergency repositories under evaluation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees atmospheric environmental stability, climate-controlled vault capacity, and microclimate instrumentation（CLIM）
information_points.content:
MCC-CLIM-GJJ：For Verdon Gorge Geological Repository, continuous microclimate telemetry logs across the main holding chambers over a thirty-day baseline period indicate a maximum peak-to-trough relative humidity daily variance of 6 %. The dedicated Grade-A environmental conservation chambers encompass a climate-controlled vault area of 600 m2 of usable floor area served by precision HVAC units according to architectural floor plan schedules.
MCC-CLIM-2CB：For Saint-Paul Subterranean Vault, continuous microclimate telemetry logs across the main holding chambers over a thirty-day baseline period record a maximum peak-to-trough relative humidity daily variance of 4 %. Architectural floor plan schedules indicate that the dedicated Grade-A environmental conservation chambers provide a climate-controlled vault area of 600 m2 of usable floor area served by precision HVAC units.
MCC-CLIM-3V4：For Luberon Redoubt Archival Bunker, continuous microclimate telemetry logs over a thirty-day baseline period across the main holding chambers document a maximum peak-to-trough relative humidity daily variance of 3 %. Furthermore, architectural floor plan schedules confirm that the climate-controlled vault area for dedicated Grade-A environmental conservation chambers totals 1000 m2 of usable floor space served by precision HVAC units.

information_points.title: Air filtration certification（FILT）
information_points.content:
MCC-FILT-Z6N：For Luberon Redoubt Archival Bunker, the chemical and particulate filtration train exhibits an air exchange particulate efficiency of 92 % single-pass capture efficiency for sub-micron particulate matter according to the HVAC validation certificate.
MCC-FILT-Q1R：For Saint-Paul Subterranean Vault, the HVAC validation certificate for the chemical and particulate filtration train indicates an air exchange particulate efficiency of 96 % single-pass capture efficiency for sub-micron particulate matter.
MCC-FILT-619：For Verdon Gorge Geological Repository, the HVAC validation certificate for the chemical and particulate filtration train demonstrates an air exchange particulate efficiency of 99 % single-pass capture efficiency for sub-micron particulate matter.
